none_means: No qualifying prior reference verified; not a proof of novelty.

problem_class.label: convex
problem_class.details: Unconstrained minimization of an everywhere differentiable convex function f:E→ℝ on a second-countable real Hilbert space. A minimizer x⋆ exists with ‖x0−x⋆‖≤R and f(x0)−f(x⋆)≤Δ; strong convexity is not required.

oracle.label: stochastic_gradient
oracle.details: Each call at x returns g(x,ξ) using a fresh IID sample. The jointly measurable oracle is unbiased, E[g(x,ξ)]=∇f(x), with integrable squared error. Only stochastic gradients are supplied; function values and f⋆ are unavailable.
oracle.evidence: LongTails/Setups/GapSmoothStrongGrowth.lean: IsStrongGrowthOracle; spec.Query, spec.Reply, and spec.admissible. LongTails/Setups/StochasticGeneralizedSmoothAndConvex.lean: IID.

distinctive_assumptions.label: generalized_smoothness
distinctive_assumptions.details: For every x,y with (2√3+√6)√H1‖y−x‖≤1, f(y)≤f(x)+⟨∇f(x),y−x⟩+[H0+H1(f(x)−f(x⋆))]‖y−x‖². H0,H1≥0; no second derivatives or global gradient Lipschitz bound are required.

distinctive_assumptions.label: relative_error
distinctive_assumptions.details: Mean-square strong-growth noise: E‖g(x,ξ)−∇f(x)‖²≤(ρ−1)‖∇f(x)‖², with ρ≥1. This is a relative variance bound, not a pointwise error bound; no bounded-support or exponential-tail condition is imposed.

distinctive_assumptions.label: other
distinctive_assumptions.details: All parameters, including H0,H1,R,Δ,ρ,ε,δ,x0 and the ambient space, are public. R,Δ>0, 0<ε≤Δ, and 0<δ<1. The objective, minimizer, sampling law, and oracle map are hidden. Geometry is Hilbert-space geometry without a finite-dimensional restriction; samples are independent and identically distributed.
distinctive_assumptions.evidence: LongTails/Setups/GapSmoothStrongGrowth.lean: Params; spec.Public, publicInput, valid, and admissible. LongTails/Setups/StochasticGeneralizedSmoothAndConvex.lean: IID.

accuracy.label: objective_gap
accuracy.details: Return a measurable E-valued output x̂ satisfying f(x̂)−f(x⋆)≤ε for a global minimizer x⋆. No particular iterate or averaging rule is prescribed.

accuracy.label: high_probability
accuracy.details: P(f(x̂)−f(x⋆)>ε)≤δ under the joint algorithm and oracle randomness. Oracle cost is bounded for every realization by the supplied fixed budget, including every individual sample call.

setup_category.label: non_standard
setup_category.reason: The setup combines a local optimality-gap-dependent smoothness model with an IID unbiased strong-growth oracle having only second-moment control, and requires high-probability objective accuracy under a fixed gradient-only budget in a Hilbert space.
